channel.description: What happened to the Argonauts and Leaves of one house.

item.title: Hermion #8500 went up to the Mist-terraces and asked the Pythia. Chewing laurel, she said:
item.description: Hermion #8500 went up to the Mist-terraces and asked the Pythia. Chewing laurel, she said: "The house of Hermion will be cut down to the root, and a green shoot will rise from the stump." Xenope #4141 the Twice-Born will interpret it.
